interface.basis: The 40 MP X-Trans CMOS 5 HR of the X-T5, X-H2, X-E5 and X100VI. Read gate: register 0x59 bit 2, which the X100VI and X-T5 boots set before they read sensor registers. Standby: register 0 bit 0, set at reset and cleared by the stock wake programming. Fast readout: X-T5 4.31 contrast AF selects register 0x01 = 7, a readout of 6 us lines (432 clocks at 72 MHz, mode table 0x36d9fb8 row 96). The X-H2, X-E5 and X100VI share the chip; these facts are not measured on them.
